risk: Unauthorised changes to employee master data — salary, bank details, status — result in incorrect or fraudulent payments.
control_objective: Ensure changes to employee master data are authorised and independently verified before they affect pay.
control: All changes to salary, bank details and employment status are entered by HR Operations from an authorised change form and independently verified against source documentation by a second HR officer before the next payroll run; a system-generated change report is reviewed by the HR Manager each period.
sod: The person entering the master data change cannot verify or approve it, and neither may release the payroll payment.
test_design: Inspect the change authorisation form, verification requirement and the period-end change report.
test_oe: Select a sample of master data changes; agree each to an authorised form and evidence of independent verification.
population: All employee master data changes in the period

risk: Bonus and incentive accruals are not supported by approved plans or actual performance outcomes, misstating employment costs.
control_objective: Ensure incentive accruals reflect approved plan terms and the current performance outcome.
control: Quarterly, the Reward Manager calculates the incentive accrual from approved plan rules and the latest performance forecast, and the Financial Controller reviews the calculation against plan documentation and prior-period trends before posting.
sod: The preparer of the accrual is not a participant in the plan being accrued.
test_design: Inspect the accrual methodology, plan documentation and evidence of Controller review.
test_oe: For a sample of quarters, re-perform the accrual from plan rules and performance data.

risk: Severance and termination payments are made outside policy or delegated authority, or leavers continue to be paid after their exit date.
control_objective: Ensure termination payments are authorised, calculated correctly, and that pay ceases on the exit date.
control: Termination payments are calculated by HR from the employment contract and policy, approved at the authority level set by value, and a leaver exception report comparing termination dates to the payroll master is reviewed by the HR Manager before each payroll run.
sod: The manager initiating the termination does not approve the settlement amount alone.
test_design: Inspect the severance authority matrix and the leaver exception report design.
test_oe: Select a sample of terminations; recompute the settlement, agree the approval, and test that pay ceased on the exit date.
